verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing claims one-click equity compliance reports for meeting compliance deadlines, plus automated error flags for compliance risks, so cap-table-driven compliance reporting exists in general form. Nothing ties it to the US-specific obligations in the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of Rule 701 disclosure-threshold tracking, Form 3921 generation or filing, 83(b) election handling, documentation of what the compliance reports contain, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
